capabilities: Wrap typed or pasted text in addition markup
Preserve deleted text as deletion markup
Accept or reject a change at the cursor or all changes
Jump to next or previous change from a floating indicator
Fall back to HTML ins tags when Extended Markdown Syntax is absent
disambiguation: Not a diff or version-history tool; it marks edits inline as you type rather than comparing saved versions of a note.
extras: Additions fall back to native HTML <ins> tags when Extended Markdown Syntax is missing; the fallback can be overridden in settings (Auto, Force ++...++, Force <ins>). The floating indicator label is in Chinese (「追蹤修訂中」).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark additions and deletions while editing, so deleted text is lost and edits leave no visible record in the note.

relations.evidence: ++...++ syntax depends on Extended Markdown Syntax (extended-markdown-syntax).

summary: Track-changes mode that wraps typed text in ++addition++ markup and keeps deleted text as %%~~deletion~~%% in Live Preview and Source Mode.
